context_inventory.source:
* Packages

Every Go program is made up of packages.

Programs start running in package `main`.

This program is using the packages with import paths `"fmt"` and `"math/rand"`.

By convention, the package name is the same as the last element of the import path. For instance, the `"math/rand"` package comprises files that begin with the statement `package`rand`.

.play basics/packages.go
context_inventory.target:
* 包

每个 Go 程序都是由包组成的。

程序从包 `main` 开始运行。

这个程序使用了导入路径为 `"fmt"` 和 `"math/rand"` 的包。

按照惯例，包名与导入路径的最后一个元素相同。例如， `"math/rand"` 包由以语句 `package`rand` 开头的文件组成。

.play basics/packages.go

context_inventory.source:
* Short variable declarations

Inside a function, the `:=` short assignment statement can be used in place of a `var` declaration with implicit type.

Outside a function, every statement begins with a keyword (`var`, `func`, and so on) and so the `:=` construct is not available.

.play basics/short-variable-declarations.go
context_inventory.target:
* 短变量声明

在函数内部，可以使用 `:=` 短赋值语句，替代带隐式类型的 `var` 声明。

在函数外部，每条语句都以关键字开头（ `var`、 `func` 等），因此不能使用 `:=` 这种写法。

.play basics/short-variable-declarations.go

context_inventory.source:
* Basic types

Go's basic types are

	bool

	string

	int  int8  int16  int32  int64
	uint uint8 uint16 uint32 uint64 uintptr

	byte // alias for uint8

	rune // alias for int32
	     // represents a Unicode code point

	float32 float64

	complex64 complex128

The example shows variables of several types,
and also that variable declarations may be "factored" into blocks,
as with import statements.

The `int`, `uint`, and `uintptr` types are usually 32 bits wide on 32-bit systems and 64 bits wide on 64-bit systems.
When you need an integer value you should use `int` unless you have a specific reason to use a sized or unsigned integer type.

.play basics/basic-types.go
context_inventory.target:
* 基本类型

Go 的基本类型包括

	bool

	string

	int  int8  int16  int32  int64
	uint uint8 uint16 uint32 uint64 uintptr

	byte // 是 uint8 的别名

	rune // 是 int32 的别名
	     // 表示一个 Unicode 码点

	float32 float64

	complex64 complex128

本例展示了几种不同类型的变量，
还展示了变量声明可以像导入语句一样“分组”到代码块中。

`int`、 `uint` 和 `uintptr` 类型在 32 位系统上通常为 32 位宽，在 64 位系统上通常为 64 位宽。
当你需要一个整数值时，应使用 `int`，除非你有明确理由使用固定位宽或无符号整数类型。

.play basics/basic-types.go

context_inventory.source:
* Zero values

Variables declared without an explicit initial value are given their
_zero_value_.

The zero value is:

- `0` for numeric types,
- `false` for the boolean type, and
- `""` (the empty string) for strings.

.play basics/zero.go
context_inventory.target:
* 零值

声明变量时如果没有明确指定初始值，它会被赋予相应的
_零值_。

零值为：

- 数值类型为 `0`，
- 布尔类型为 `false`，以及
- 字符串为 `""`（空字符串）。

.play basics/zero.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type conversions

The expression `T(v)` converts the value `v` to the type `T`.

Some numeric conversions:

	var i int = 42
	var f float64 = float64(i)
	var u uint = uint(f)

Or, put more simply:

	i := 42
	f := float64(i)
	u := uint(f)

Unlike in C, in Go assignment between items of different type requires an
explicit conversion.
Try removing the `float64` or `uint` conversions in the example and see what happens.

.play basics/type-conversions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型转换

表达式 `T(v)` 将值 `v` 转换为类型 `T`。

一些数值转换：

	var i int = 42
	var f float64 = float64(i)
	var u uint = uint(f)

或者，更简洁地写成：

	i := 42
	f := float64(i)
	u := uint(f)

与 C 不同，在 Go 中，不同类型的值之间进行赋值时需要
显式转换。
试着删除示例中的 `float64` 或 `uint` 转换，看看会发生什么。

.play basics/type-conversions.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type inference

When declaring a variable without specifying an explicit type (either by using the `:=` syntax or `var`=` expression syntax), the variable's type is inferred from the value on the right hand side.

When the right hand side of the declaration is typed, the new variable is of that same type:

	var i int
	j := i // j is an int

But when the right hand side contains an untyped numeric constant, the new variable may be an `int`, `float64`, or `complex128` depending on the precision of the constant:

	i := 42           // int
	f := 3.142        // float64
	g := 0.867 + 0.5i // complex128

Try changing the initial value of `v` in the example code and observe how its type is affected.

.play basics/type-inference.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型推断

声明变量但未指定显式类型时（无论使用 `:=` 语法，还是 `var`=` 表达式语法），变量的类型都会根据右侧的值推断出来。

当声明右侧的值有明确类型时，新变量也具有相同的类型：

	var i int
	j := i // j 是 int

但是，当右侧包含无类型数值常量时，新变量可能是 `int`、 `float64` 或 `complex128`，具体取决于该常量的精度：

	i := 42           // int
	f := 3.142        // float64
	g := 0.867 + 0.5i // complex128

试着修改示例代码中 `v` 的初始值，观察它的类型如何随之变化。

.play basics/type-inference.go

* Constants

Constants are declared like variables, but with the `const` keyword.

Constants can be character, string, boolean, or numeric values.

Constants cannot be declared using the `:=` syntax.

.play basics/constants.go
context_inventory.target:
* 常量

常量的声明方式与变量类似，但使用 `const` 关键字。

常量可以是字符、字符串、布尔值或数值。

不能使用 `:=` 语法声明常量。

.play basics/constants.go

context_inventory.source:

Numeric constants are high-precision _values_.

An untyped constant takes the type needed by its context.

Try printing `needInt(Big)` too.

(An `int` can store at maximum a 64-bit integer, and sometimes less.)

.play basics/numeric-constants.go
context_inventory.target:

无类型常量会根据上下文取得所需的类型。

也试着打印 `needInt(Big)`。

（一个 `int` 最多可以存储 64 位整数，有时会更少。）

.play basics/numeric-constants.go

context_inventory.source:
* Exported names

In Go, a name is exported if it begins with a capital letter.
For example, `Pizza` is an exported name, as is `Pi`, which is exported from
the `math` package.

`pizza` and `pi` do not start with a capital letter, so they are not exported.

When importing a package, you can refer only to its exported names.
Any "unexported" names are not accessible from outside the package.

Run the code. Notice the error message.

To fix the error, rename `math.pi` to `math.Pi` and try it again.

.play basics/exported-names.go
context_inventory.target:
* 导出名

在 Go 中，如果一个名称以大写字母开头，那么它就是导出名。
例如， `Pizza` 是一个导出名， `Pi` 也是，它由
`math` 包导出。

`pizza` 和 `pi` 都不是以大写字母开头，因此它们不会被导出。

导入一个包后，你只能引用其中的导出名。
任何“未导出的名称”都无法从包外访问。

运行代码。注意错误信息。

* Functions

A function can take zero or more arguments.

In this example, `add` takes two parameters of type `int`.

Notice that the type comes _after_ the variable name.

(For more about why types look the way they do, see the [[/blog/gos-declaration-syntax][article on Go's declaration syntax]].)

.play basics/functions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 函数

函数可以接收零个或多个参数。

在这个例子中， `add` 接收两个类型为 `int` 的参数。

请注意，类型写在变量名的 _后面_。

（有关类型为何采用这种写法的更多信息，请参阅 [[/blog/gos-declaration-syntax][关于 Go 声明语法的文章]]。）

.play basics/functions.go

context_inventory.source:
* Functions continued

When two or more consecutive named function parameters share a type, you can omit the type from all but the last.

In this example, we shortened

	x int, y int

to

	x, y int

.play basics/functions-continued.go
context_inventory.target:
* 函数（续）

当两个或多个连续的具名函数参数具有相同类型时，可以省略除最后一个参数之外其他参数的类型。

在这个例子中，我们将

	x int, y int

简写为

	x, y int

.play basics/functions-continued.go

context_inventory.source:
* Named return values

Go's return values may be named. If so, they are treated as variables defined at the top of the function.

These names should be used to document the meaning of the return values.

A `return` statement without arguments returns the named return values. This is known as a "naked" return.

Naked return statements should be used only in short functions, as with the example shown here. They can harm readability in longer functions.

.play basics/named-results.go
context_inventory.target:
* 命名返回值

Go 的返回值可以被命名。如果命名了返回值，它们会被视为定义在函数顶部的变量。

这些名称应当用于说明返回值的含义。

不带参数的 `return` 语句会返回命名返回值。这称为“裸返回”。

裸返回语句只应在短函数中使用，就像这里展示的示例一样。在较长的函数中使用裸返回会影响可读性。

.play basics/named-results.go

* Variables

The `var` statement declares a list of variables; as in function argument lists, the type is last.

A `var` statement can be at package or function level. We see both in this example.

.play basics/variables.go
context_inventory.target:
* 变量

`var` 语句声明一组变量；与函数参数列表一样，类型写在最后。

`var` 语句既可以位于包级别，也可以位于函数级别。本例中两种情况都有。

.play basics/variables.go

context_inventory.source:
* Variables with initializers

A `var` declaration can include initializers, one per variable.

If an initializer is present, the type can be omitted; the variable will take the type of the initializer.

.play basics/variables-with-initializers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 带初始值的变量

`var` 声明可以包含初始值，每个变量对应一个初始值。

如果指定了初始值，可以省略类型；变量会采用初始值的类型。

.play basics/variables-with-initializers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Goroutines

A _goroutine_ is a lightweight thread managed by the Go runtime.

	go f(x, y, z)

starts a new goroutine running

	f(x, y, z)

The evaluation of `f`, `x`, `y`, and `z` happens in the current goroutine and the execution of `f` happens in the new goroutine.

Goroutines run in the same address space, so access to shared memory must be synchronized. The [[/pkg/sync/][`sync`]] package provides useful primitives, although you won't need them much in Go as there are other primitives. (See the next slide.)

.play concurrency/goroutines.go
context_inventory.target:
* Goroutines

一个 _goroutine_ 是由 Go 运行时管理的轻量级线程。

	go f(x, y, z)

会启动一个新的 goroutine 来运行

	f(x, y, z)

`f`、 `x`、 `y` 和 `z` 的求值发生在当前 goroutine 中，而 `f` 的执行发生在新的 goroutine 中。

Goroutines 运行在同一个地址空间中，因此对共享内存的访问必须进行同步。[[/pkg/sync/][`sync`]] 包提供了实用的同步原语，不过在 Go 中你并不会经常用到它们，因为还有其他原语可用。（见下一页。）

.play concurrency/goroutines.go

* Channels

Channels are a typed conduit through which you can send and receive values with the channel operator, `<-`.

	ch <- v    // Send v to channel ch.
	v := <-ch  // Receive from ch, and
	           // assign value to v.

(The data flows in the direction of the arrow.)

Like maps and slices, channels must be created before use:

	ch := make(chan int)

By default, sends and receives block until the other side is ready. This allows goroutines to synchronize without explicit locks or condition variables.

The example code sums the numbers in a slice, distributing the work between two goroutines.
Once both goroutines have completed their computation, it calculates the final result.

.play concurrency/channels.go
context_inventory.target:
* 通道

通道是一种带类型的通路，你可以通过它使用通道操作符 `<-` 发送和接收值。

	ch <- v    // 将 v 发送到通道 ch。
	v := <-ch  // 从 ch 接收，并
	           // 将值赋给 v。

（数据沿箭头方向流动。）

与映射和切片一样，通道在使用前必须先创建：

	ch := make(chan int)

默认情况下，发送和接收操作会一直阻塞，直到另一端准备就绪。这使得 goroutines 无需显式使用锁或条件变量即可完成同步。

示例代码对一个切片中的数字求和，并将工作分配给两个 goroutines。
当两个 goroutines 都完成计算后，它会计算最终结果。

.play concurrency/channels.go

context_inventory.source:
* Buffered Channels

Channels can be _buffered_.  Provide the buffer length as the second argument to `make` to initialize a buffered channel:

	ch := make(chan int, 100)

Sends to a buffered channel block only when the buffer is full. Receives block when the buffer is empty.

Modify the example to overfill the buffer and see what happens.

.play concurrency/buffered-channels.go
context_inventory.target:
* 缓冲通道

通道可以是 _带缓冲的_。将缓冲区长度作为 `make` 的第二个参数，即可初始化一个带缓冲的通道：

	ch := make(chan int, 100)

向带缓冲通道发送数据时，只有缓冲区已满才会阻塞。接收操作会在缓冲区为空时阻塞。

修改示例，让写入的数据超过缓冲区容量，看看会发生什么。

.play concurrency/buffered-channels.go

context_inventory.source:
* Range and Close

A sender can `close` a channel to indicate that no more values will be sent. Receivers can test whether a channel has been closed by assigning a second parameter to the receive expression: after

	v, ok := <-ch

`ok` is `false` if there are no more values to receive and the channel is closed.

The loop `for`i`:=`range`c` receives values from the channel repeatedly until it is closed.

*Note:* Only the sender should close a channel, never the receiver. Sending on a closed channel will cause a panic.

*Another*note:* Channels aren't like files; you don't usually need to close them. Closing is only necessary when the receiver must be told there are no more values coming, such as to terminate a `range` loop.

.play concurrency/range-and-close.go
context_inventory.target:
* range 和 close

发送者可以 `close` 一个通道，以表示不会再发送任何值。接收者可以通过接收表达式的第二个返回值来检测通道是否已关闭：执行

	v, ok := <-ch

之后，如果已经没有值可以接收且通道已关闭， `ok` 就会是 `false`。

循环 `for`i`:=`range`c` 会不断从通道接收值，直到通道关闭。

*注意：* 只有发送者应该关闭通道，接收者不应关闭。向已经关闭的通道发送值会引发 panic。

*另一个注意事项：* 通道与文件不同，通常不需要关闭。只有在必须告知接收者不会再有值到来时才需要关闭通道，例如为了终止 `range` 循环。

.play concurrency/range-and-close.go

context_inventory.source:
* Select

The `select` statement lets a goroutine wait on multiple communication operations.

A `select` blocks until one of its cases can run, then it executes that case.  It chooses one at random if multiple are ready.

.play concurrency/select.go
context_inventory.target:
* select

`select` 语句使一个 goroutine 可以等待多个通信操作。

* sync.Mutex

We've seen how channels are great for communication among goroutines.

But what if we don't need communication? What if we just want to make sure only
one goroutine can access a variable at a time to avoid conflicts?

This concept is called _mutual_exclusion_, and the conventional name for the data structure that provides it is _mutex_.

Go's standard library provides mutual exclusion with
[[/pkg/sync/#Mutex][`sync.Mutex`]] and its two methods:

- `Lock`
- `Unlock`

We can define a block of code to be executed in mutual exclusion by surrounding it
with a call to `Lock` and `Unlock` as shown on the `Inc` method.

We can also use `defer` to ensure the mutex will be unlocked as in the `Value` method.

.play concurrency/mutex-counter.go

我们已经看到，通道非常适合用于 goroutines 之间的通信。

但如果我们并不需要通信呢？如果我们只是想确保每次只有
一个 goroutine 能访问某个变量，从而避免冲突呢？

这个概念称为 _互斥_，而提供这种机制的数据结构通常称为 _互斥锁_。

Go 的标准库通过
[[/pkg/sync/#Mutex][`sync.Mutex`]] 及其两个方法提供互斥机制：

- `Lock`
- `Unlock`

通过在代码块前后分别调用 `Lock` 和 `Unlock`，就可以让它以互斥方式执行，正如 `Inc` 方法所示。

我们还可以使用 `defer` 来确保互斥锁最终会被解锁，如 `Value` 方法所示。

* For

Go has only one looping construct, the `for` loop.

The basic `for` loop has three components separated by semicolons:

- the init statement: executed before the first iteration
- the condition expression: evaluated before every iteration
- the post statement: executed at the end of every iteration

The init statement will often be a variable declaration, and the
variables declared there are visible only in the scope of the `for`
statement.

The loop will stop iterating once the boolean condition evaluates to `false`.

*Note:* Unlike other languages like C, Java, or JavaScript there are no parentheses
surrounding the three components of the `for` statement and the braces `{`}` are
always required.

.play flowcontrol/for.go
context_inventory.target:
* For

Go 只有一种循环结构： `for` 循环。

基本的 `for` 循环由三个用分号隔开的部分组成：

- 初始化语句：在第一次迭代前执行
- 条件表达式：在每次迭代前求值
- 后置语句：在每次迭代结束时执行

初始化语句通常是一个变量声明，其中声明的变量只在
`for` 语句的作用域内可见。

一旦布尔条件求值为 `false`，循环就会停止迭代。

*注意：* 与 C、Java 或 JavaScript 等其他语言不同，
`for` 语句的三个部分外不需要小括号，但花括号 `{`}` 始终是必需的。

.play flowcontrol/for.go

* Exercise: Loops and Functions

As a way to play with functions and loops, let's implement a square root function: given a number x, we want to find the number z for which z² is most nearly x.

Computers typically compute the square root of x using a loop.
Starting with some guess z, we can adjust z based on how close z² is to x,
producing a better guess:

	z -= (z*z - x) / (2*z)

Repeating this adjustment makes the guess better and better
until we reach an answer that is as close to the actual square root as can be.

Implement this in the `func`Sqrt` provided.
A decent starting guess for z is 1, no matter what the input.
To begin with, repeat the calculation 10 times and print each z along the way.
See how close you get to the answer for various values of x (1, 2, 3, ...)
and how quickly the guess improves.

Hint: To declare and initialize a floating point value,
give it floating point syntax or use a conversion:

	z := 1.0
	z := float64(1)

Next, change the loop condition to stop once the value has stopped
changing (or only changes by a very small amount).
See if that's more or fewer than 10 iterations.
Try other initial guesses for z, like x, or x/2.
How close are your function's results to the [[/pkg/math/#Sqrt][math.Sqrt]] in the standard library?

(*Note:* If you are interested in the details of the algorithm, the z² − x above
is how far away z² is from where it needs to be (x), and the division by 2z is the derivative
of z², to scale how much we adjust z by how quickly z² is changing.
This general approach is called [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method][Newton's method]].
It works well for many functions but especially well for square root.)

.play flowcontrol/exercise-loops-and-functions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 练习：循环与函数

为了练习函数和循环，我们来实现一个平方根函数：给定一个数 x，希望找到一个数 z，使 z² 尽可能接近 x。

计算机通常使用循环来计算 x 的平方根。
从某个猜测值 z 开始，我们可以根据 z² 与 x 的接近程度来调整 z，
从而得到一个更好的猜测值：

	z -= (z*z - x) / (2*z)

反复进行这种调整，猜测值会越来越准确，
直到得到一个尽可能接近实际平方根的答案。

请在提供的 `func`Sqrt` 中实现这一算法。
无论输入是什么，z 的一个不错的初始猜测值都是 1。
首先，将计算重复 10 次，并在过程中打印每次得到的 z。
看看对于不同的 x 值（1、2、3……），结果与答案有多接近，
以及猜测值改进得有多快。

提示：要声明并初始化一个浮点数值，
可以使用浮点数语法，或者进行类型转换：

	z := 1.0
	z := float64(1)

接下来，修改循环条件，使它在值不再变化
（或仅发生非常小的变化）时停止。
看看这需要的迭代次数比 10 次更多还是更少。
尝试 z 的其他初始猜测值，例如 x 或 x/2。
你的函数结果与标准库中的 [[/pkg/math/#Sqrt][math.Sqrt]] 有多接近？

（*注意：* 如果你对算法的细节感兴趣，上面的 z² − x 表示 z² 距离它应达到的值（x）有多远，而除以 2z 中的 2z 是 z² 的导数，
用于根据 z² 变化的快慢来缩放对 z 的调整量。
这种通用方法称为 [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method][牛顿法]]。
它适用于许多函数，但对平方根尤其有效。）

.play flowcontrol/exercise-loops-and-functions.go

* Switch

A `switch` statement is a shorter way to write a sequence of `if`-`else` statements.
It runs the first case whose value is equal to the condition expression.

Go's switch is like the one in C, C++, Java, JavaScript, and PHP,
except that Go only runs the selected case, not all the cases that follow.
In effect, the `break` statement that is needed at the end of each case in those
languages is provided automatically in Go.
Another important difference is that Go's switch cases need not
be constants, and the values involved need not be integers.

.play flowcontrol/switch.go
context_inventory.target:
* Switch

`switch` 语句是编写一连串 `if`-`else` 语句的更简洁方式。
它会执行第一个值与条件表达式相等的分支。

Go 的 switch 与 C、C++、Java、JavaScript 和 PHP 中的 switch 类似，
不同之处在于 Go 只会执行选中的分支，而不会继续执行后面的所有分支。
实际上，在这些语言中每个分支末尾所需的 `break` 语句，
在 Go 中会自动完成。
另一个重要区别是，Go 的 switch 分支不必是常量，
其中涉及的值也不必是整数。

.play flowcontrol/switch.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type parameters

Go functions can be written to work on multiple types using type parameters. The
type parameters of a function appear between brackets, before the function's
arguments.

  func Index[T comparable](s []T, x T) int

This declaration means that `s` is a slice of any type `T` that fulfills the
built-in constraint `comparable`. `x` is also a value of the same type.

`comparable` is a useful constraint that makes it possible to use the `==` and
`!=` operators on values of the type. In this example, we use it to compare a
value to all slice elements until a match is found. This `Index` function works
for any type that supports comparison.

.play generics/index.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型参数

Go 函数可以使用类型参数来编写，从而适用于多种类型。函数的
类型参数位于方括号中，并出现在函数的
参数之前。

  func Index[T comparable](s []T, x T) int

这个声明表示 `s` 是一个由任意类型 `T` 构成的切片，而该类型满足
内置约束 `comparable`。 `x` 也是同一类型的值。

`comparable` 是一个很有用的约束，它允许对该类型的值使用 `==` 和
`!=` 运算符。在这个例子中，我们用它将一个
值依次与切片中的所有元素进行比较，直到找到匹配项。这个 `Index` 函数
适用于任何支持比较的类型。

.play generics/index.go

* Type assertions

A _type_assertion_ provides access to an interface value's underlying concrete value.

	t := i.(T)

This statement asserts that the interface value `i` holds the concrete type `T`
and assigns the underlying `T` value to the variable `t`.

If `i` does not hold a `T`, the statement will trigger a panic.

To _test_ whether an interface value holds a specific type,
a type assertion can return two values: the underlying value
and a boolean value that reports whether the assertion succeeded.

	t, ok := i.(T)

If `i` holds a `T`, then `t` will be the underlying value and `ok` will be true.

If not, `ok` will be false and `t` will be the zero value of type `T`,
and no panic occurs.

Note the similarity between this syntax and that of reading from a map.

.play methods/type-assertions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型断言

_类型断言_ 用于访问接口值所保存的底层具体值。

	t := i.(T)

该语句断言接口值 `i` 保存了具体类型 `T`，
并将底层的 `T` 值赋给变量 `t`。

如果 `i` 并未保存 `T`，该语句会触发 panic。

要 _测试_ 接口值是否保存了某个特定类型，
类型断言可以返回两个值：底层值
以及一个表示断言是否成功的布尔值。

	t, ok := i.(T)

如果 `i` 保存了 `T`，那么 `t` 将是底层值，而 `ok` 将为 true。

否则， `ok` 将为 false，而 `t` 将是类型 `T` 的零值，
并且不会发生 panic。

请注意，这种语法与从映射中读取值的语法很相似。

.play methods/type-assertions.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type switches

A _type_switch_ is a construct that permits several type assertions in series.

A type switch is like a regular switch statement, but the cases in a type
switch specify types (not values), and those values are compared against
the type of the value held by the given interface value.

	switch v := i.(type) {
	case T:
		// here v has type T
	case S:
		// here v has type S
	default:
		// no match; here v has the same type as i
	}

The declaration in a type switch has the same syntax as a type assertion `i.(T)`,
but the specific type `T` is replaced with the keyword `type`.

This switch statement tests whether the interface value `i`
holds a value of type `T` or `S`.
In each of the `T` and `S` cases, the variable `v` will be of type
`T` or `S` respectively and hold the value held by `i`.
In the default case (where there is no match), the variable `v` is
of the same interface type and value as `i`.

.play methods/type-switches.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型选择

_类型选择_ 是一种允许连续进行多个类型断言的结构。

类型选择与普通的 switch 语句类似，但类型选择中的 case
指定的是类型（而不是值），这些类型会与给定接口值中
所保存值的类型进行比较。

	switch v := i.(type) {
	case T:
		// 此处 v 的类型为 T
	case S:
		// 此处 v 的类型为 S
	default:
		// 无匹配；此处 v 的类型与 i 相同
	}

类型选择中的声明与类型断言 `i.(T)` 的语法相同，
只是将具体类型 `T` 替换为关键字 `type`。

这个 switch 语句会检查接口值 `i`
中保存的值是否为 `T` 或 `S` 类型。
在 `T` 和 `S` 两个分支中，变量 `v` 的类型
分别为 `T` 和 `S`，并保存 `i` 中保存的值。
在 default 分支（即没有匹配项）中，变量 `v`
与 `i` 具有相同的接口类型和值。

.play methods/type-switches.go

* Errors

Go programs express error state with `error` values.

The `error` type is a built-in interface similar to `fmt.Stringer`:

	type error interface {
		Error() string
	}

(As with `fmt.Stringer`, the `fmt` package looks for the `error` interface when
printing values.)

Functions often return an `error` value, and calling code should handle errors
by testing whether the error equals `nil`.

	i, err := strconv.Atoi("42")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("couldn't convert number: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("Converted integer:", i)

A nil `error` denotes success; a non-nil `error` denotes failure.

.play methods/errors.go
context_inventory.target:

Go 程序使用 `error` 值表示错误状态。

`error` 类型是一个内置接口，类似于 `fmt.Stringer`：

	type error interface {
		Error() string
	}

（与 `fmt.Stringer` 类似， `fmt` 包在
打印值时也会检查待打印的值是否实现了 `error` 接口。）

函数通常会返回一个 `error` 值，调用方应通过判断该错误是否为
`nil` 来处理错误。

	i, err := strconv.Atoi("42")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("couldn't convert number: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("Converted integer:", i)

`error` 为 nil 表示成功；非 nil 的 `error` 表示失败。

* Readers

The `io` package specifies the `io.Reader` interface,
which represents the read end of a stream of data.

The Go standard library contains [[https://cs.opensource.google/search?q=Read%5C(%5Cw%2B%5Cs%5C%5B%5C%5Dbyte%5C)&ss=go%2Fgo][many implementations]] of this interface, including files, network connections, compressors, ciphers, and others.

The `io.Reader` interface has a `Read` method:

	func (T) Read(b []byte) (n int, err error)

`Read` populates the given byte slice with data and returns the number of bytes
populated and an error value. It returns an `io.EOF` error when the stream
ends.

The example code creates a
[[/pkg/strings/#Reader][`strings.Reader`]]
and consumes its output 8 bytes at a time.

.play methods/reader.go
context_inventory.target:

Go 标准库包含该接口的[[https://cs.opensource.google/search?q=Read%5C(%5Cw%2B%5Cs%5C%5B%5C%5Dbyte%5C)&ss=go%2Fgo][许多实现]]，包括文件、网络连接、压缩器、加密器等。

`io.Reader` 接口有一个 `Read` 方法：

	func (T) Read(b []byte) (n int, err error)

`Read` 会用数据填充给定的字节切片，并返回填充的字节数和错误值。
当数据流结束时，它会返回 `io.EOF` 错误。

context_inventory.source:
* Pointer receivers

You can declare methods with pointer receivers.

This means the receiver type has the literal syntax `*T` for some type `T`.
(Also, `T` cannot itself be a pointer such as `*int`.)

For example, the `Scale` method here is defined on `*Vertex`.

Methods with pointer receivers can modify the value to which the receiver
points (as `Scale` does here).
Since methods often need to modify their receiver, pointer receivers are more
common than value receivers.

Try removing the `*` from the declaration of the `Scale` function on line 16
and observe how the program's behavior changes.

With a value receiver, the `Scale` method operates on a copy of the original
`Vertex` value.
(This is the same behavior as for any other function argument.)
The `Scale` method must have a pointer receiver to change the `Vertex` value
declared in the `main` function.

.play methods/methods-pointers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 指针接收者

你可以声明使用指针接收者的方法。

这意味着接收者类型使用字面语法 `*T`，其中 `T` 是某个类型。
（另外， `T` 本身不能是像 `*int` 这样的指针。）

例如，这里的 `Scale` 方法定义在 `*Vertex` 上。

使用指针接收者的方法可以修改接收者所指向的值
（这里的 `Scale` 就是如此）。
由于方法经常需要修改其接收者，因此指针接收者比值接收者更常见。

试着删除 `*`，也就是第 16 行 `Scale` 函数声明中的星号，
然后观察程序的行为如何变化。

使用值接收者时， `Scale` 方法操作的是原始
`Vertex` 值的副本。
（这与其他任何函数参数的行为相同。）
`Scale` 方法必须使用指针接收者，才能修改 `Vertex` 值；
这个值声明在 `main` 函数中。

context_inventory.source:
* Methods and pointer indirection

Comparing the previous two programs, you might notice that
functions with a pointer argument must take a pointer:

	var v Vertex
	ScaleFunc(v, 5)  // Compile error!
	ScaleFunc(&v, 5) // OK

while methods with pointer receivers take either a value or a pointer as the
receiver when they are called:

	var v Vertex
	v.Scale(5)  // OK
	p := &v
	p.Scale(10) // OK

For the statement `v.Scale(5)`, even though `v` is a value and not a pointer,
the method with the pointer receiver is called automatically.
That is, as a convenience, Go interprets the statement `v.Scale(5)` as
`(&v).Scale(5)` since the `Scale` method has a pointer receiver.

.play methods/indirection.go
context_inventory.target:
* 方法与指针间接引用

比较前两个程序，你可能会注意到，
带有指针参数的函数必须接收一个指针：

	var v Vertex
	ScaleFunc(v, 5)  // 编译错误！
	ScaleFunc(&v, 5) // OK

而使用指针接收者的方法在调用时，接收者既可以是值，也可以是指针：

	var v Vertex
	v.Scale(5)  // OK
	p := &v
	p.Scale(10) // OK

对于语句 `v.Scale(5)`，即使 `v` 是一个值而不是指针，
也会自动调用使用指针接收者的方法。
也就是说，为了方便，Go 会把语句 `v.Scale(5)` 解释为
`(&v).Scale(5)`，因为 `Scale` 方法使用指针接收者。

.play methods/indirection.go

context_inventory.source:
* Methods and pointer indirection (2)

The equivalent thing happens in the reverse direction.

Functions that take a value argument must take a value of that specific type:

	var v Vertex
	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(v))  // OK
	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(&v)) // Compile error!

while methods with value receivers take either a value or a pointer as the
receiver when they are called:

	var v Vertex
	fmt.Println(v.Abs()) // OK
	p := &v
	fmt.Println(p.Abs()) // OK

In this case, the method call `p.Abs()` is interpreted as `(*p).Abs()`.

.play methods/indirection-values.go
context_inventory.target:
* 方法与指针间接引用（2）

反过来也会发生类似的情况。

带有值参数的函数必须接收该特定类型的值：

	var v Vertex
	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(v))  // OK
	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(&v)) // 编译错误！

而使用值接收者的方法在调用时，接收者既可以是值，也可以是指针：

	var v Vertex
	fmt.Println(v.Abs()) // OK
	p := &v
	fmt.Println(p.Abs()) // OK

在这种情况下，方法调用 `p.Abs()` 会被解释为 `(*p).Abs()`。

.play methods/indirection-values.go

context_inventory.source:
* Choosing a value or pointer receiver

There are two reasons to use a pointer receiver.

The first is so that the method can modify the value that its receiver points to.

The second is to avoid copying the value on each method call.
This can be more efficient if the receiver is a large struct, for example.

In this example, both `Scale` and `Abs` are methods with receiver type `*Vertex`,
even though the `Abs` method needn't modify its receiver.

In general, all methods on a given type should have either value or pointer
receivers, but not a mixture of both.
(We'll see why over the next few pages.)

.play methods/methods-with-pointer-receivers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 选择值接收者还是指针接收者

使用指针接收者有两个原因。

第一，方法可以修改其接收者所指向的值。

第二，可以避免每次调用方法时都复制该值。
例如，如果接收者是一个大型结构体，这样做可能会更高效。

在这个例子中， `Scale` 和 `Abs` 都是接收者类型为 `*Vertex` 的方法，
尽管 `Abs` 方法并不需要修改其接收者。

一般来说，一个给定类型的所有方法应该统一使用值接收者或指针接收者，
而不应混合使用两者。
（接下来的几页会说明原因。）

.play methods/methods-with-pointer-receivers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Pointers

Go has pointers.
A pointer holds the memory address of a value.

The type `*T` is a pointer to a `T` value. Its zero value is `nil`.

	var p *int

The `&` operator generates a pointer to its operand.

	i := 42
	p = &i

The `*` operator denotes the pointer's underlying value.

	fmt.Println(*p) // read i through the pointer p
	*p = 21         // set i through the pointer p

This is known as "dereferencing" or "indirecting".

Unlike C, Go has no pointer arithmetic.

.play moretypes/pointers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 指针

Go 有指针。
指针保存一个值的内存地址。

类型 `*T` 是指向 `T` 类型值的指针。它的零值为 `nil`。

	var p *int

`&` 运算符会生成一个指向其操作数的指针。

	i := 42
	p = &i

`*` 运算符表示指针所指向的底层值。

	fmt.Println(*p) // 通过指针 p 读取 i
	*p = 21         // 通过指针 p 设置 i

这称为“解引用”或“间接引用”。

与 C 不同，Go 没有指针运算。

.play moretypes/pointers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slice defaults

When slicing, you may omit the high or low bounds to use their defaults instead.

The default is zero for the low bound and the length of the underlying slice or array for the high bound.

For the array

	var a [10]int

these slice expressions are equivalent:

	a[0:10]
	a[:10]
	a[0:]
	a[:]

.play moretypes/slice-bounds.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片的默认边界

进行切片时，可以省略上界或下界，从而使用它们的默认值。

下界的默认值为 0，上界的默认值为底层切片或数组的长度。

对于数组

	var a [10]int

下面这些切片表达式是等价的：

	a[0:10]
	a[:10]
	a[0:]
	a[:]

.play moretypes/slice-bounds.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slice length and capacity

A slice has both a _length_ and a _capacity_.

The length of a slice is the number of elements it contains.

The capacity of a slice is the number of elements in the underlying array,
counting from the first element in the slice.

The length and capacity of a slice `s` can be obtained using the expressions
`len(s)` and `cap(s)`.

You can extend a slice's length by re-slicing it,
provided it has sufficient capacity.
Try changing one of the slice operations in the example program to extend it
beyond its capacity and see what happens.

.play moretypes/slice-len-cap.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片的长度与容量

切片同时具有 _length_（长度）和 _capacity_（容量）。

切片的长度就是它所包含的元素个数。

切片的容量是从切片的第一个元素开始计算，底层数组中可用的元素个数。

切片 `s` 的长度和容量可以分别通过表达式
`len(s)` 和 `cap(s)` 获得。

只要容量足够，就可以通过重新切片来扩展切片的长度。
试着修改示例程序中的某个切片操作，让它扩展到超过自身容量的范围，看看会发生什么。

.play moretypes/slice-len-cap.go

The zero value of a slice is `nil`.

A nil slice has a length and capacity of 0
and has no underlying array.

.play moretypes/nil-slices.go

切片的零值为 `nil`。

nil 切片的长度和容量均为 0，

context_inventory.source:
* Creating a slice with make

Slices can be created with the built-in `make` function;
this is how you create dynamically-sized arrays.

The `make` function allocates a zeroed array
and returns a slice that refers to that array:

	a := make([]int, 5)  // len(a)=5

To specify a capacity, pass a third argument to `make`:

	b := make([]int, 0, 5) // len(b)=0, cap(b)=5

	b = b[:cap(b)] // len(b)=5, cap(b)=5
	b = b[1:]      // len(b)=4, cap(b)=4

.play moretypes/making-slices.go
context_inventory.target:
* 使用 make 创建切片

可以使用内置的 `make` 函数创建切片；
这就是创建动态大小数组的方式。

`make` 函数会分配一个元素均为零值的数组，
并返回一个引用该数组的切片：

	a := make([]int, 5)  // len(a)=5

要指定容量，可以向 `make` 传入第三个参数：

	b := make([]int, 0, 5) // len(b)=0, cap(b)=5

	b = b[:cap(b)] // len(b)=5, cap(b)=5
	b = b[1:]      // len(b)=4, cap(b)=4

.play moretypes/making-slices.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slices of slices

Slices can contain any type, including other slices.

.play moretypes/slices-of-slice.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片的切片

切片可以包含任何类型，包括其他切片。

.play moretypes/slices-of-slice.go

context_inventory.source:
* Appending to a slice

It is common to append new elements to a slice, and so Go provides a built-in
`append` function. The [[/pkg/builtin/#append][documentation]]
of the built-in package describes `append`.

	func append(s []T, vs ...T) []T

The first parameter `s` of `append` is a slice of type `T`, and the rest are
`T` values to append to the slice.

The resulting value of `append` is a slice containing all the elements of the
original slice plus the provided values.

If the backing array of `s` is too small to fit all the given values a bigger
array will be allocated. The returned slice will point to the newly allocated
array.

(To learn more about slices, read the [[/blog/go-slices-usage-and-internals][Slices: usage and internals]] article.)

.play moretypes/append.go
context_inventory.target:
* 向切片追加元素

向切片追加新元素很常见，因此 Go 提供了内置的
`append` 函数。内置包的 [[/pkg/builtin/#append][文档]]
介绍了 `append`。

	func append(s []T, vs ...T) []T

`s` 是 `append` 的第一个参数，它是一个元素类型为 `T` 的切片，其余参数则是
要追加到该切片中的 `T` 类型的值。

`append` 返回的切片包含原切片的所有元素以及所提供的值。

如果 `s` 的底层数组太小，无法容纳所有给定的值，就会分配一个更大的数组。返回的切片将指向这个新分配的数组。

（要进一步了解切片，请阅读 [[/blog/go-slices-usage-and-internals][切片：用法和内部实现]] 一文。）

.play moretypes/append.go

context_inventory.source:
* Range

The `range` form of the `for` loop iterates over a slice or map.

When ranging over a slice, two values are returned for each iteration.
The first is the index, and the second is a copy of the element at that index.

.play moretypes/range.go
context_inventory.target:
* Range

`range` 是 `for` 循环的一种形式，可用于遍历切片或映射。

遍历切片时，每次迭代都会返回两个值。
第一个是索引，第二个是该索引处元素的副本。

.play moretypes/range.go

    for _, value := range pow

If you only want the index, you can omit the second variable.

.play moretypes/range-continued.go
context_inventory.target:

    for i, _ := range pow
    for _, value := range pow

如果只需要索引，可以省略第二个变量。

A map maps keys to values.

The zero value of a map is `nil`.
A `nil` map has no keys, nor can keys be added.

The `make` function returns a map of the given type,
initialized and ready for use.

context_inventory.target:

映射将键映射到值。

映射的零值为 `nil`。
一个 `nil` 映射没有任何键，也不能向其中添加键。

`make` 函数会返回指定类型的映射，

A `struct` is a collection of fields.

If the top-level type is just a type name, you can omit it from the elements of the literal.

context_inventory.source:
* Mutating Maps

Insert or update an element in map `m`:

	m[key] = elem

Retrieve an element:

	elem = m[key]

Delete an element:

	delete(m, key)

Test that a key is present with a two-value assignment:

	elem, ok = m[key]

If `key` is in `m`, `ok` is `true`. If not, `ok` is `false`.

If `key` is not in the map, then `elem` is the zero value for the map's element type.

*Note:* If `elem` or `ok` have not yet been declared you could use a short declaration form:

	elem, ok := m[key]

.play moretypes/mutating-maps.go
context_inventory.target:
* 修改映射

在映射 `m` 中插入或更新元素：

	m[key] = elem

获取元素：

	elem = m[key]

删除元素：

	delete(m, key)

使用双赋值来测试某个键是否存在：

	elem, ok = m[key]

如果 `key` 存在于 `m` 中，则 `ok` 为 `true`；否则， `ok` 为 `false`。

如果 `key` 不在映射中，那么 `elem` 将是该映射元素类型的零值。

*注意：* 如果 `elem` 或 `ok` 尚未声明，可以使用短变量声明形式：

	elem, ok := m[key]

.play moretypes/mutating-maps.go

* Function values

Functions are values too. They can be passed around just like other values.

Function values may be used as function arguments and return values.

context_inventory.target:

函数也是值。它们可以像其他值一样被传递。

函数值可以用作函数参数和返回值。

.play moretypes/function-values.go

context_inventory.source:
* Function closures

Go functions may be closures. A closure is a function value that references variables from outside its body. The function may access and assign to the referenced variables; in this sense the function is "bound" to the variables.

For example, the `adder` function returns a closure. Each closure is bound to its own `sum` variable.

.play moretypes/function-closures.go
context_inventory.target:
* 函数闭包

Go 的函数可以是闭包。闭包是一个引用其函数体之外变量的函数值。函数可以访问这些被引用的变量，也可以为它们赋值；从这个意义上说，函数与这些变量是“绑定”的。

例如， `adder` 函数会返回一个闭包。每个闭包都绑定到各自的 `sum` 变量。

.play moretypes/function-closures.go

returns successive [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fibonacci_number][fibonacci numbers]]

Struct fields can be accessed through a struct pointer.

To access the field `X` of a struct when we have the struct pointer `p` we could
write `(*p).X`.
However, that notation is cumbersome, so the language permits us instead to
write just `p.X`, without the explicit dereference.

context_inventory.target:
* 指向结构体的指针

可以通过结构体指针访问结构体字段。

要访问结构体的字段 `X`，而我们持有的是结构体指针 `p`，可以
写成 `(*p).X`。

A struct literal denotes a newly allocated struct value by listing the values of its fields.

You can list just a subset of fields by using the `Name:` syntax. (And the order of named fields is irrelevant.)

The special prefix `&` returns a pointer to the struct value.

.play moretypes/struct-literals.go

使用 `Name:` 语法时，可以只列出部分字段。（已命名字段的顺序无关紧要。）

context_inventory.source:
* Arrays

The type `[n]T` is an array of `n` values of type `T`.

The expression

	var a [10]int

declares a variable `a` as an array of ten integers.

An array's length is part of its type, so arrays cannot be resized.
This seems limiting, but don't worry;
Go provides a convenient way of working with arrays.

.play moretypes/array.go
context_inventory.target:
* 数组

类型 `[n]T` 表示一个由 `n` 个 `T` 类型的值组成的数组。

表达式

	var a [10]int

将变量 `a` 声明为一个包含十个整数的数组。

数组的长度是其类型的一部分，因此数组不能调整大小。
这看起来有些受限，但不用担心；
Go 提供了处理数组的便捷方式。

.play moretypes/array.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slices

An array has a fixed size.
A slice, on the other hand, is a dynamically-sized,
flexible view into the elements of an array.
In practice, slices are much more common than arrays.

The type `[]T` is a slice with elements of type `T`.

A slice is formed by specifying two indices, a low and
high bound, separated by a colon:

	a[low : high]

This selects a half-open range which includes the first
element, but excludes the last one.

The following expression creates a slice which includes
elements 1 through 3 of `a`:

	a[1:4]

.play moretypes/slices.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片

数组的大小是固定的。
而切片则是对数组中一段元素的、大小动态可变的灵活视图。
在实际使用中，切片比数组更常见。

类型 `[]T` 表示一个元素类型为 `T` 的切片。

通过指定两个索引来形成切片，即由冒号分隔的下界和上界：

	a[low : high]

这会选择一个半开区间，其中包含第一个元素，但不包含最后一个元素。

下面的表达式创建了一个切片，其中包含 `a` 中索引 1 到 3 的元素：

	a[1:4]

.play moretypes/slices.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slices are like references to arrays

A slice does not store any data,
it just describes a section of an underlying array.

Changing the elements of a slice modifies the
corresponding elements of its underlying array.

Other slices that share the same underlying array will see those changes.

.play moretypes/slices-pointers.go
context_inventory.target:

切片本身并不存储任何数据，
它只是描述了底层数组中的一段。

修改切片中的元素，会同时修改其底层数组中对应的元素。

共享同一个底层数组的其他切片也会看到这些变化。

.play moretypes/slices-pointers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slice literals

A slice literal is like an array literal without the length.

This is an array literal:

	[3]bool{true, true, false}

And this creates the same array as above,
then builds a slice that references it:

	[]bool{true, true, false}

.play moretypes/slice-literals.go
context_inventory.target:

切片字面量就像省略了长度的数组字面量。

这是一个数组字面量：

	[3]bool{true, true, false}

而下面的写法会创建与上面相同的数组，
然后构建一个引用该数组的切片：

	[]bool{true, true, false}

.play moretypes/slice-literals.go

* Go offline (optional)

This tour is also available as a stand-alone program that you can use
without access to the internet. It builds and runs the code samples on
your own machine.

To run the tour locally, you'll need to first
[[/doc/install][install Go]] and then run:

  go install golang.org/x/website/tour@latest

This will place a `tour` binary in your
[[/cmd/go/#hdr-GOPATH_and_Modules][GOPATH]]'s `bin` directory.
When you run the tour program, it will open a web browser displaying
your local version of the tour.

Of course, you can continue to take the tour through this web site.

* The Go Playground

This tour is built atop the [[https://play.golang.org/][Go Playground]], a
web service that runs on [[/][golang.org]]'s servers.

The service receives a Go program, compiles, links, and runs the program inside
a sandbox, then returns the output.

There are limitations to the programs that can be run in the playground:

- In the playground the time begins at 2009-11-10 23:00:00 UTC (determining the significance of this date is an exercise for the reader). This makes it easier to cache programs by giving them deterministic output.

- There are also limits on execution time and on CPU and memory usage, and the program cannot access external network hosts.

The playground uses the latest stable release of Go.

Read "[[/blog/playground][Inside the Go Playground]]" to learn more.

.play welcome/sandbox.go

* Go 语言演练场

本教程构建在 [[https://play.golang.org/][Go 语言演练场]] 之上，这是一个运行在 [[/][golang.org]] 服务器上的 Web 服务。

该服务接收一个 Go 程序，在沙箱中编译、链接并运行该程序，然后返回输出结果。

演练场中可运行的程序存在一些限制：

- 在演练场中，时间从 2009-11-10 23:00:00 UTC 开始（这个日期有什么特殊含义，就留给读者作为练习）。通过让程序产生确定性输出，这样更容易缓存程序。

- 执行时间以及 CPU 和内存使用量也有限制，并且程序无法访问外部网络主机。

演练场使用最新的稳定版 Go。

阅读“[[/blog/playground][深入了解 Go 语言演练场]]”以了解更多信息。

.play welcome/sandbox.go
讲解 Go 程序由包组成、程序从 main 包开始运行，以及导入路径最后一项通常与包名相同的惯例。
介绍函数内部使用短变量声明替代隐式类型 var 声明的方式，并说明这种写法为何不能用于函数外部。
概览 Go 的布尔、字符串、整数、浮点数和复数等基本类型，说明变量声明分组方式及整数类型的选择建议。
讲解未显式指定初始值的变量会获得零值，并分别说明数值、布尔类型和字符串对应的零值。
介绍将值转换为指定类型的表达式，并说明 Go 在不同类型的值之间赋值时需要进行显式转换。
讲解省略显式类型时的类型推断，比较右侧为有类型值与无类型数值常量时，新变量类型的确定方式。
说明使用 const 关键字声明字符、字符串、布尔值或数值常量，并指出短变量声明语法不能用于常量。
介绍数值常量是高精度值、无类型常量会根据上下文取得所需类型，并说明 int 可存储整数的范围限制。
提示这一课已经完成，并说明可以返回模块列表选择后续学习内容，也可以直接继续下一课。
比较分别编写多个导入语句与使用括号分组的写法，并说明分组导入语句是更好的 Go 代码风格。
说明大写字母开头的导出名如何决定包外访问权限，并通过将未导出的 pi 改为导出的 Pi 来理解包外访问限制。
介绍 Go 函数可以接收任意数量的参数，并以 add 函数为例说明参数类型写在变量名之后的声明语法。
讲解多个连续的具名函数参数具有相同类型时，如何仅在最后一个参数后保留类型，使声明更简洁。
通过返回两个字符串的 swap 函数，说明 Go 函数可以一次返回任意数量的返回值。
介绍命名返回值及其说明作用、不带参数的裸返回，并解释为何裸返回只适合较短的函数以免影响可读性。
讲解 var 语句如何声明一组变量、类型在列表中的位置，以及变量声明可以位于包级别或函数级别。
说明 var 声明可为每个变量提供初始值，并在有初始值时省略显式类型，让变量采用初始值的类型。
介绍由 Go 运行时管理的轻量级线程 goroutine，说明启动与求值过程，以及共享内存访问必须同步的原因。
练习运用 Go 并发特性并行执行 Web 爬虫，在避免重复抓取同一 URL 的同时安全管理已抓取记录。
为教程结束后的继续学习提供资料指引，涵盖 Go 文档、标准库、语言规范、并发模式、Web 应用、函数类型和博客。
讲解 goroutines 之间通过带类型的通道发送和接收值、阻塞等待对端，并以分工求和展示无需显式锁的同步。
介绍使用 make 指定容量来创建缓冲通道，并说明缓冲区满时发送会阻塞、缓冲区空时接收会阻塞。
讲解发送者关闭通道、接收者检测关闭状态及使用 range 持续接收的方法，并说明何时需要关闭以及误用会引发 panic。
介绍 select 如何让 goroutine 等待多个通信操作，在某个分支可执行时选择它，并在多个分支就绪时随机选择。
讲解 select 中的 default 分支会在其他分支均未就绪时执行，从而尝试不会阻塞的通道发送或接收。
以不同形状却保存相同序列的二叉树为背景，介绍利用 Go 并发机制和通道判断等价性的练习目标及 Tree 类型。
练习实现并测试 Walk 来遍历二叉树并向通道发送值，再实现 Same 判断两棵树是否保存相同的值。
介绍防止 goroutines 并发访问变量产生冲突的互斥机制，以及使用 sync.Mutex、Lock、Unlock 和 defer 保护代码。
介绍 Go 唯一的循环结构 for，说明初始化语句、条件表达式和后置语句的执行时机、变量作用域、终止条件以及括号与花括号规则。
说明 switch 分支会从上到下依次求值，并在第一个匹配成功的分支处停止，不再计算后续条件。
讲解不带条件的 switch 与以 true 为条件的写法等价，可用于简洁表达较长的 if-then-else 链。
介绍 defer 将函数调用推迟到外围函数返回时执行，但被延迟调用所使用的参数会立即求值。
讲解多个 defer 调用会被压入栈中，并在外围函数返回时按照后进先出的顺序依次执行。
在课程结束后提供两种继续方式：回到模块列表寻找新的学习主题，或者紧接着进入下一课。
在基本 for 循环的基础上，说明初始化语句和后置语句都属于可选部分，可以根据需要省略。
说明省去初始化语句和后置语句后还可以省略分号，此时 Go 的 for 就相当于 C 语言中的 while。
讲解省略 for 的循环条件会让循环持续运行，从而用非常简洁的形式表达无限循环。
介绍 Go 的 if 语句与 for 循环相似的语法规则：条件表达式不需要括号，但大括号始终必需。
讲解 if 可在判断条件前先执行一条简短语句，并说明其中声明的变量只在整个 if 语句内有效。
说明 if 简短语句中声明的变量也可用于各个 else 代码块，并结合函数调用解释示例中的求值顺序。
练习使用循环和函数，以牛顿法反复改进猜测值来实现平方根计算，并比较停止条件、初始值与标准库结果。
介绍 switch 如何执行首个匹配分支、自动结束该分支，以及 Go 的分支条件不必是常量或整数等特点。
介绍函数的类型参数和内置 comparable 约束，借助可比较类型的 Index 函数在切片中逐项查找匹配值。
讲解如何用类型参数定义泛型类型，并以可保存任意类型值的单链表说明泛型数据结构，再通过练习扩展其功能。
确认当前课程内容已学完，并提供返回模块目录查找新主题或顺序继续下一课的导航选择。
说明没有类的 Go 如何为类型定义方法，并介绍位于 func 关键字和方法名之间的特殊接收者参数。
讲解类型只需实现所需方法便会隐式实现接口，无需 implements 声明，从而让接口定义与具体实现彼此解耦。
将接口值理解为值与具体类型组成的元组，并说明在接口值上调用方法时会执行其底层类型的同名方法。
说明接口内部的具体值为 nil 时仍会以 nil 接收者调用方法，同时该接口值本身并不等于 nil。
讲解 nil 接口值既不保存值也不保存具体类型，因此无法确定要调用的方法，并会在方法调用时产生运行时错误。
介绍零方法的空接口可保存任意类型值，说明 any 是 interface{} 的完全等价别名，并展示其处理未知类型值及 fmt.Print 参数的用途。
讲解类型断言如何访问接口值的底层具体值，以及断言失败时触发 panic 或用双返回值安全判断的两种方式。
介绍类型选择如何连续执行多个类型断言，根据接口值所保存值的类型进入不同分支，并确定分支变量的类型和值。
介绍 fmt 包定义的 Stringer 接口，以及能够用字符串描述自身的类型如何被 fmt 等包用于打印值。
练习让 IPAddr 类型实现 fmt.Stringer，使四个数值组成的地址能够以点分四组的字符串形式打印。
介绍表示错误状态的内置 error 接口，并说明函数调用方如何通过 error 是否为 nil 来区分成功与失败。
通过把 Vertex 的 Abs 方法改写为功能相同的普通函数，说明方法本质上是带接收者参数的函数。
练习修改 Sqrt 以返回 error，为负数定义 ErrNegativeSqrt 错误类型，并分析 Error 方法中可能出现的无限循环。
介绍表示数据流读取端的 io.Reader 接口与 Read 方法，说明返回的读取字节数、错误值和流结束时的 io.EOF，并演示 strings.Reader 的分块读取。
练习实现 Reader 类型，使其能够持续生成由 ASCII 字符 A 组成的无限数据流。
练习实现包装另一个 io.Reader 的 rot13Reader，通过 Read 方法对数据流中的所有字母应用 rot13 替换密码。
介绍 image 包的 Image 接口及其颜色模型、边界和取色方法，并说明相关返回类型与预定义颜色实现。
练习定义自己的 Image 类型，实现 image.Image 所需的边界、颜色模型和取色方法，并将结果显示为图片。
完成本课后，可以返回模块列表挑选新的学习方向，或者不离开当前学习流程而直接进入下一课。
说明非结构体类型也可以声明方法，但接收者类型必须与方法定义在同一个包中，不能来自其他包或内置类型。
讲解指针接收者方法可以修改所指向的值，并通过 Scale 对比值接收者只操作原始 Vertex 副本的行为。
将 Abs 和 Scale 方法改写成普通函数，通过移除指针标记来观察行为变化，并思考编译所需的其他调整。
比较函数与方法的指针间接引用：指针参数必须传入指针，而指针接收者方法可由值自动取地址后调用。
从相反方向说明值参数函数必须接收值，而值接收者方法也能通过指针调用，此时 Go 会自动进行解引用。
说明选择指针接收者的两个原因：修改所指向的值和避免每次调用复制数据，并给出同一类型统一接收者形式的建议。
介绍由一组方法签名定义的接口类型，以及接口类型的值如何保存实现这些方法的值，并分析 Vertex 示例中的错误。
介绍保存内存地址的指针、指针类型及其零值，以及取地址和解引用运算，并说明 Go 不支持指针运算。
讲解切片表达式省略下界或上界时采用的默认值，并比较多种表示同一完整范围的等价写法。
说明切片长度与容量的含义和获取方式，以及在容量足够时通过重新切片扩展长度，并观察超出容量时的结果。
介绍切片的零值 nil，说明 nil 切片的长度和容量均为零，而且不存在底层数组。
讲解内置 make 函数如何分配零值数组并返回引用它的切片，以及如何分别指定切片的长度和容量。
说明切片可以容纳任意类型的元素，包括把其他切片作为元素来组织嵌套数据。
介绍内置 append 函数如何向切片添加值，并说明底层数组容量不足时会分配更大的数组并返回新切片。
讲解使用 for 的 range 形式遍历切片或映射，以及遍历切片时每次迭代得到索引和元素副本的规则。
说明 range 遍历时如何忽略不需要的索引或值，以及只需要索引时省略第二个变量的简化写法。
练习实现 Pic 函数，创建由 8 位无符号整数切片组成的二维切片，并把计算出的数值解释为颜色来显示图片。
介绍将键关联到值的映射，说明 nil 映射不能添加键，以及如何使用 make 得到已初始化且可用的映射。
通过简短示例介绍 Go 的 struct，说明结构体是一组相关字段组成的集合。
说明映射字面量的写法与结构体字面量相似，但映射中的每个元素都必须明确指定键。
讲解映射字面量的顶层类型只是类型名时，可以在各个元素中省略重复的类型名称。
介绍映射元素的插入、更新、获取和删除，并通过双赋值判断键是否存在及处理不存在时的零值。
练习实现 WordCount，返回记录字符串中每个单词出现次数的映射，并使用提供的测试检查成功或失败。
说明函数在 Go 中也是值，可以像其他值一样传递，并可作为另一个函数的参数或返回值。
介绍闭包如何引用、访问和修改函数体外的变量，并说明每个返回的闭包都会绑定自己的变量。
练习实现 fibonacci 函数，让它返回一个闭包，并在后续调用中依次生成斐波那契数。
告知学习者本课已经结束，并引导其从模块列表寻找接下来的内容，或继续进入后续课程。
说明如何使用点号选择并访问结构体中的字段，掌握结构体字段访问的基本方式。
讲解通过结构体指针访问字段时，可以使用与结构体值相同的点号写法，而不必显式进行解引用。
介绍结构体字面量如何列出字段值、按名称选择部分字段且不受顺序限制，以及如何获得结构体值的指针。
讲解由元素数量和元素类型表示的 Go 数组，并说明数组长度属于类型的一部分，因此数组不能调整大小。
介绍切片是数组元素的动态灵活视图，说明切片类型，以及下界包含、上界不包含的半开区间取值规则。
说明切片本身不存储数据，而是描述底层数组的一段；修改元素会影响底层数组及共享它的其他切片。
比较数组字面量与不指定长度的切片字面量，说明后者会创建数组并构建一个引用该数组的切片。
介绍 Go 语言之旅的模块与目录导航，以及运行、编辑和格式化示例程序、切换语法高亮等交互式学习操作。
列出本教程提供的巴西葡萄牙语、日语、西班牙语等其他语言版本，并说明如何继续前往下一页。
确认本教程的第一个模块已经完成，并引导学习者查看其他 Go 学习内容或直接进入下一课。
说明如何安装 Go 并在自己的计算机上运行独立版教程，从而离线构建和执行代码示例，同时也可继续使用网站版本。

import (

// LanguageLink describes one build-time language site exposed on the
// homepage. Registry order is presentation order and is shared by every
// locale build.
type LanguageLink struct {
	Locale      string
	EnglishName string
	Autonym     string
	Label       string
	URL         string
	Official    bool

	location, err := time.LoadLocation(name)

func languagesFor(locale string) ([]LanguageLink, error) {
	if _, ok := localeProfiles[locale]; !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported site locale %q", locale)
	}
	languages := make([]LanguageLink, len(languageRegistry))
	copy(languages, languageRegistry)
	for i := range languages {
		languages[i].Label = languages[i].EnglishName
		if languages[i].EnglishName != languages[i].Autonym {
			languages[i].Label += " — " + languages[i].Autonym
		}
		languages[i].Current = languages[i].Locale == locale
	}
	return languages, nil
}

func currentLanguage(languages []LanguageLink) (LanguageLink, error) {
	for _, language := range languages {
		if language.Current {
			return language, nil
		}
	}
	return LanguageLink{}, fmt.Errorf("language registry has no current locale")
}

Every Go program is made up of packages.

Programs start running in package `main`.

This program is using the packages with import paths `"fmt"` and `"math/rand"`.

The expression `T(v)` converts the value `v` to the type `T`.

Some numeric conversions:

	var i int = 42
	var f float64 = float64(i)
	var u uint = uint(f)

Or, put more simply:

	i := 42
	f := float64(i)
	u := uint(f)

* Type inference

When declaring a variable without specifying an explicit type (either by using the `:=` syntax or `var`=` expression syntax), the variable's type is inferred from the value on the right hand side.

When the right hand side of the declaration is typed, the new variable is of that same type:

	var i int
	j := i // j is an int

But when the right hand side contains an untyped numeric constant, the new variable may be an `int`, `float64`, or `complex128` depending on the precision of the constant:

	i := 42           // int
	f := 3.142        // float64
	g := 0.867 + 0.5i // complex128

Try changing the initial value of `v` in the example code and observe how its type is affected.

.play basics/type-inference.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型推断

声明变量但未指定显式类型时（无论使用 `:=` 语法，还是 `var`=` 表达式语法），变量的类型都会根据右侧的值推断出来。

当声明右侧的值有明确类型时，新变量也具有相同的类型：

	var i int
	j := i // j 是 int

但是，当右侧包含无类型数值常量时，新变量可能是 `int`、 `float64` 或 `complex128`，具体取决于该常量的精度：

	i := 42           // int
	f := 3.142        // float64
	g := 0.867 + 0.5i // complex128

In Go, a name is exported if it begins with a capital letter.
For example, `Pizza` is an exported name, as is `Pi`, which is exported from
the `math` package.

`pizza` and `pi` do not start with a capital letter, so they are not exported.

When importing a package, you can refer only to its exported names.

A _goroutine_ is a lightweight thread managed by the Go runtime.

	go f(x, y, z)

	f(x, y, z)

The evaluation of `f`, `x`, `y`, and `z` happens in the current goroutine and the execution of `f` happens in the new goroutine.

Goroutines run in the same address space, so access to shared memory must be synchronized. The [[/pkg/sync/][`sync`]] package provides useful primitives, although you won't need them much in Go as there are other primitives. (See the next slide.)

* Channels

Channels are a typed conduit through which you can send and receive values with the channel operator, `<-`.

	ch <- v    // Send v to channel ch.
	v := <-ch  // Receive from ch, and
	           // assign value to v.

(The data flows in the direction of the arrow.)

Like maps and slices, channels must be created before use:

	ch := make(chan int)

By default, sends and receives block until the other side is ready. This allows goroutines to synchronize without explicit locks or condition variables.

The example code sums the numbers in a slice, distributing the work between two goroutines.
Once both goroutines have completed their computation, it calculates the final result.

.play concurrency/channels.go
context_inventory.target:
* 通道

通道是一种带类型的通路，你可以通过它使用通道操作符 `<-` 发送和接收值。

	ch <- v    // 将 v 发送到通道 ch。
	v := <-ch  // 从 ch 接收，并
	           // 将值赋给 v。

（数据沿箭头方向流动。）

与映射和切片一样，通道在使用前必须先创建：

	ch := make(chan int)

默认情况下，发送和接收操作会一直阻塞，直到另一端准备就绪。这使得 goroutine 无需显式使用锁或条件变量即可完成同步。

示例代码对一个切片中的数字求和，并将工作分配给两个 goroutine。
当两个 goroutine 都完成计算后，它会计算最终结果。

.play concurrency/channels.go

context_inventory.source:
* Buffered Channels

Channels can be _buffered_.  Provide the buffer length as the second argument to `make` to initialize a buffered channel:

	ch := make(chan int, 100)

Sends to a buffered channel block only when the buffer is full. Receives block when the buffer is empty.

Modify the example to overfill the buffer and see what happens.

.play concurrency/buffered-channels.go
context_inventory.target:

通道可以是 _带缓冲的_。将缓冲区长度作为 `make` 的第二个参数，即可初始化一个带缓冲的通道：

	ch := make(chan int, 100)

向带缓冲通道发送数据时，只有缓冲区已满才会阻塞。接收操作会在缓冲区为空时阻塞。

修改示例，让写入的数据超过缓冲区容量，看看会发生什么。

context_inventory.source:
* Range and Close

A sender can `close` a channel to indicate that no more values will be sent. Receivers can test whether a channel has been closed by assigning a second parameter to the receive expression: after

	v, ok := <-ch

`ok` is `false` if there are no more values to receive and the channel is closed.

The loop `for`i`:=`range`c` receives values from the channel repeatedly until it is closed.

*Note:* Only the sender should close a channel, never the receiver. Sending on a closed channel will cause a panic.

*Another*note:* Channels aren't like files; you don't usually need to close them. Closing is only necessary when the receiver must be told there are no more values coming, such as to terminate a `range` loop.

.play concurrency/range-and-close.go
context_inventory.target:
* range 和 close

发送者可以 `close` 一个通道，以表示不会再发送任何值。接收者可以通过接收表达式的第二个返回值来检测通道是否已关闭：执行

	v, ok := <-ch

之后，如果已经没有值可以接收且通道已关闭， `ok` 就会是 `false`。

循环 `for`i`:=`range`c` 会不断从通道接收值，直到通道关闭。

*注意：* 只有发送者应该关闭通道，接收者不应关闭。向已经关闭的通道发送值会引发 panic。

*另一个注意事项：* 通道与文件不同，通常不需要关闭。只有在必须告知接收者不会再有值到来时才需要关闭通道，例如为了终止 `range` 循环。

.play concurrency/range-and-close.go

* sync.Mutex

We've seen how channels are great for communication among goroutines.

But what if we don't need communication? What if we just want to make sure only
one goroutine can access a variable at a time to avoid conflicts?

This concept is called _mutual_exclusion_, and the conventional name for the data structure that provides it is _mutex_.

Go's standard library provides mutual exclusion with
[[/pkg/sync/#Mutex][`sync.Mutex`]] and its two methods:

- `Lock`
- `Unlock`

We can define a block of code to be executed in mutual exclusion by surrounding it
with a call to `Lock` and `Unlock` as shown on the `Inc` method.

We can also use `defer` to ensure the mutex will be unlocked as in the `Value` method.

.play concurrency/mutex-counter.go
context_inventory.target:
* sync.Mutex

我们已经看到，通道非常适合用于 goroutine 之间的通信。

但如果我们并不需要通信呢？如果我们只是想确保每次只有
一个 goroutine 能访问某个变量，从而避免冲突呢？

这个概念称为 _互斥_，而提供这种机制的数据结构通常称为 _互斥锁_。

Go 的标准库通过
[[/pkg/sync/#Mutex][`sync.Mutex`]] 及其两个方法提供互斥机制：

- `Lock`
- `Unlock`

通过在代码块前后分别调用 `Lock` 和 `Unlock`，就可以让它以互斥方式执行，正如 `Inc` 方法所示。

我们还可以使用 `defer` 来确保互斥锁最终会被解锁，如 `Value` 方法所示。

.play concurrency/mutex-counter.go

* For

Go has only one looping construct, the `for` loop.

The basic `for` loop has three components separated by semicolons:

- the init statement: executed before the first iteration
- the condition expression: evaluated before every iteration
- the post statement: executed at the end of every iteration

The init statement will often be a variable declaration, and the
variables declared there are visible only in the scope of the `for`
statement.

The loop will stop iterating once the boolean condition evaluates to `false`.

*Note:* Unlike other languages like C, Java, or JavaScript there are no parentheses
surrounding the three components of the `for` statement and the braces `{`}` are
always required.

.play flowcontrol/for.go
context_inventory.target:
* For

Go 只有一种循环结构： `for` 循环。

基本的 `for` 循环由三个用分号隔开的部分组成：

- 初始化语句：在第一次迭代前执行
- 条件表达式：在每次迭代前求值
- 后置语句：在每次迭代结束时执行

初始化语句通常是一个变量声明，其中声明的变量只在
`for` 语句的作用域内可见。

一旦布尔条件求值为 `false`，循环就会停止迭代。

*注意：* 与 C、Java 或 JavaScript 等其他语言不同，
`for` 语句的三个部分外不需要小括号，但花括号 `{`}` 始终是必需的。

（例如，

	switch i {
	case 0:
	case f():
	}

其中对 `f` 的调用在 `i==0` 时不会发生。）

context_inventory.source:
* Exercise: Loops and Functions

As a way to play with functions and loops, let's implement a square root function: given a number x, we want to find the number z for which z² is most nearly x.

Computers typically compute the square root of x using a loop.
Starting with some guess z, we can adjust z based on how close z² is to x,
producing a better guess:

	z -= (z*z - x) / (2*z)

Repeating this adjustment makes the guess better and better
until we reach an answer that is as close to the actual square root as can be.

Implement this in the `func`Sqrt` provided.
A decent starting guess for z is 1, no matter what the input.
To begin with, repeat the calculation 10 times and print each z along the way.
See how close you get to the answer for various values of x (1, 2, 3, ...)
and how quickly the guess improves.

Hint: To declare and initialize a floating point value,
give it floating point syntax or use a conversion:

	z := 1.0
	z := float64(1)

Next, change the loop condition to stop once the value has stopped
changing (or only changes by a very small amount).
See if that's more or fewer than 10 iterations.
Try other initial guesses for z, like x, or x/2.
How close are your function's results to the [[/pkg/math/#Sqrt][math.Sqrt]] in the standard library?

(*Note:* If you are interested in the details of the algorithm, the z² − x above
is how far away z² is from where it needs to be (x), and the division by 2z is the derivative
of z², to scale how much we adjust z by how quickly z² is changing.
This general approach is called [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method][Newton's method]].
It works well for many functions but especially well for square root.)

.play flowcontrol/exercise-loops-and-functions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 练习：循环与函数

为了练习函数和循环，我们来实现一个平方根函数：给定一个数 x，希望找到一个数 z，使 z² 尽可能接近 x。

计算机通常使用循环来计算 x 的平方根。
从某个猜测值 z 开始，我们可以根据 z² 与 x 的接近程度来调整 z，
从而得到一个更好的猜测值：

	z -= (z*z - x) / (2*z)

反复进行这种调整，猜测值会越来越准确，
直到得到一个尽可能接近实际平方根的答案。

请在提供的 `func`Sqrt` 中实现这一算法。
无论输入是什么，z 的一个不错的初始猜测值都是 1。
首先，将计算重复 10 次，并在过程中打印每次得到的 z。
看看对于不同的 x 值（1、2、3……），结果与答案有多接近，
以及猜测值改进得有多快。

提示：要声明并初始化一个浮点数值，
可以使用浮点数语法，或者进行类型转换：

	z := 1.0
	z := float64(1)

接下来，修改循环条件，使它在值不再变化
（或仅发生非常小的变化）时停止。
看看这需要的迭代次数比 10 次更多还是更少。
尝试 z 的其他初始猜测值，例如 x 或 x/2。
你的函数结果与标准库中的 [[/pkg/math/#Sqrt][math.Sqrt]] 有多接近？

（*注意：* 如果你对算法的细节感兴趣，上面的 z² − x 表示 z² 距离它应达到的值（x）有多远，而除以 2z 中的 2z 是 z² 的导数，
用于根据 z² 变化的快慢来缩放对 z 的调整量。
这种通用方法称为 [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newton%27s_method][牛顿法]]。
它适用于许多函数，但对平方根尤其有效。）

.play flowcontrol/exercise-loops-and-functions.go

* Switch

A `switch` statement is a shorter way to write a sequence of `if`-`else` statements.
It runs the first case whose value is equal to the condition expression.

Go's switch is like the one in C, C++, Java, JavaScript, and PHP,
except that Go only runs the selected case, not all the cases that follow.
In effect, the `break` statement that is needed at the end of each case in those
languages is provided automatically in Go.
Another important difference is that Go's switch cases need not
be constants, and the values involved need not be integers.

.play flowcontrol/switch.go
context_inventory.target:
* Switch

`switch` 语句是编写一连串 `if`-`else` 语句的更简洁方式。
它会执行第一个值与条件表达式相等的分支。

Go 的 switch 与 C、C++、Java、JavaScript 和 PHP 中的 switch 类似，
不同之处在于 Go 只会执行选中的分支，而不会继续执行后面的所有分支。
实际上，在这些语言中每个分支末尾所需的 `break` 语句，
在 Go 中会自动完成。
另一个重要区别是，Go 的 switch 分支不必是常量，
其中涉及的值也不必是整数。

.play flowcontrol/switch.go

* Type parameters

Go functions can be written to work on multiple types using type parameters. The
type parameters of a function appear between brackets, before the function's
arguments.

  func Index[T comparable](s []T, x T) int

This declaration means that `s` is a slice of any type `T` that fulfills the
built-in constraint `comparable`. `x` is also a value of the same type.

`comparable` is a useful constraint that makes it possible to use the `==` and
`!=` operators on values of the type. In this example, we use it to compare a
value to all slice elements until a match is found. This `Index` function works
for any type that supports comparison.

.play generics/index.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型参数

Go 函数可以使用类型参数来编写，从而适用于多种类型。函数的
类型参数位于方括号中，并出现在函数的
参数之前。

  func Index[T comparable](s []T, x T) int

这个声明表示 `s` 是一个由任意类型 `T` 构成的切片，而该类型满足
内置约束 `comparable`。 `x` 也是同一类型的值。

`comparable` 是一个很有用的约束，它允许对该类型的值使用 `==` 和
`!=` 运算符。在这个例子中，我们用它将一个
值依次与切片中的所有元素进行比较，直到找到匹配项。这个 `Index` 函数
适用于任何支持比较的类型。

.play generics/index.go

A type implements an interface by implementing its methods.

* Interface values

Under the hood, interface values can be thought of as a tuple of a value and a
concrete type:

	(value, type)

An interface value holds a value of a specific underlying concrete type.

Calling a method on an interface value executes the method of the same name on
its underlying type.

context_inventory.target:
* 接口值

在内部，接口值可以看作由一个值和一个
具体类型组成的元组：

	(value, type)

接口值保存了一个具有特定底层具体类型的值。

在接口值上调用方法时，会执行其底层类型上

context_inventory.source:
* Interface values with nil underlying values

If the concrete value inside the interface itself is nil,
the method will be called with a nil receiver.

In some languages this would trigger a null pointer exception,
but in Go it is common to write methods that gracefully handle being called
with a nil receiver (as with the method `M` in this example.)

Note that an interface value that holds a nil concrete value is itself non-nil.

.play methods/interface-values-with-nil.go
context_inventory.target:
* 底层值为 nil 的接口值

如果接口内部的具体值本身为 nil，
调用方法时会使用 nil 接收者。

在某些语言中，这会触发空指针异常，
但在 Go 中，经常会编写能够妥善处理 nil 接收者调用的方法
（例如本例中的 `M` 方法）。

类型可用于确定应调用哪个 _具体_ 方法。

context_inventory.source:
* The empty interface

The interface type that specifies zero methods is known as the _empty_interface_:

	interface{}

An empty interface may hold values of any type.
(Every type implements at least zero methods.)

`any` is an alias for `interface{}`, and the two are completely
equivalent.

Empty interfaces are used by code that handles values of unknown type.
For example, `fmt.Print` takes any number of arguments of type `any`.

.play methods/empty-interface.go
context_inventory.target:
* 空接口

指定零个方法的接口类型称为 _空接口_：

	interface{}

空接口可保存任意类型的值。
（每种类型都至少实现了零个方法。）

`any` 是 `interface{}` 的别名，两者完全等价。

处理未知类型值的代码会使用空接口。
例如， `fmt.Print` 接受任意数量的 `any` 类型实参。

.play methods/empty-interface.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type assertions

A _type_assertion_ provides access to an interface value's underlying concrete value.

	t := i.(T)

This statement asserts that the interface value `i` holds the concrete type `T`
and assigns the underlying `T` value to the variable `t`.

If `i` does not hold a `T`, the statement will trigger a panic.

To _test_ whether an interface value holds a specific type,
a type assertion can return two values: the underlying value
and a boolean value that reports whether the assertion succeeded.

	t, ok := i.(T)

If `i` holds a `T`, then `t` will be the underlying value and `ok` will be true.

If not, `ok` will be false and `t` will be the zero value of type `T`,
and no panic occurs.

Note the similarity between this syntax and that of reading from a map.

.play methods/type-assertions.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型断言

_类型断言_ 用于访问接口值所保存的底层具体值。

	t := i.(T)

该语句断言接口值 `i` 保存了具体类型 `T`，
并将底层的 `T` 值赋给变量 `t`。

如果 `i` 并未保存 `T`，该语句会触发 panic。

要 _测试_ 接口值是否保存了某个特定类型，
类型断言可以返回两个值：底层值
以及一个表示断言是否成功的布尔值。

	t, ok := i.(T)

如果 `i` 保存了 `T`，那么 `t` 将是底层值，而 `ok` 将为 true。

否则， `ok` 将为 false，而 `t` 将是类型 `T` 的零值，
并且不会发生 panic。

请注意，这种语法与从映射中读取值的语法很相似。

.play methods/type-assertions.go

context_inventory.source:
* Type switches

A _type_switch_ is a construct that permits several type assertions in series.

A type switch is like a regular switch statement, but the cases in a type
switch specify types (not values), and those values are compared against
the type of the value held by the given interface value.

	switch v := i.(type) {
	case T:
		// here v has type T
	case S:
		// here v has type S
	default:
		// no match; here v has the same type as i
	}

The declaration in a type switch has the same syntax as a type assertion `i.(T)`,
but the specific type `T` is replaced with the keyword `type`.

This switch statement tests whether the interface value `i`
holds a value of type `T` or `S`.
In each of the `T` and `S` cases, the variable `v` will be of type
`T` or `S` respectively and hold the value held by `i`.
In the default case (where there is no match), the variable `v` is
of the same interface type and value as `i`.

.play methods/type-switches.go
context_inventory.target:
* 类型选择

_类型选择_ 是一种允许连续进行多个类型断言的结构。

类型选择与普通的 switch 语句类似，但类型选择中的 case
指定的是类型（而不是值），这些类型会与给定接口值中
所保存值的类型进行比较。

	switch v := i.(type) {
	case T:
		// 此处 v 的类型为 T
	case S:
		// 此处 v 的类型为 S
	default:
		// 无匹配；此处 v 的类型与 i 相同
	}

类型选择中的声明与类型断言 `i.(T)` 的语法相同，
只是将具体类型 `T` 替换为关键字 `type`。

这个 switch 语句会检查接口值 `i`
中保存的值是否为 `T` 或 `S` 类型。
在 `T` 和 `S` 两个分支中，变量 `v` 的类型
分别为 `T` 和 `S`，并保存 `i` 中保存的值。
在 default 分支（即没有匹配项）中，变量 `v`
与 `i` 具有相同的接口类型和值。

.play methods/type-switches.go

* Errors

Go programs express error state with `error` values.

The `error` type is a built-in interface similar to `fmt.Stringer`:

	type error interface {
		Error() string
	}

(As with `fmt.Stringer`, the `fmt` package looks for the `error` interface when
printing values.)

Functions often return an `error` value, and calling code should handle errors
by testing whether the error equals `nil`.

	i, err := strconv.Atoi("42")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("couldn't convert number: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("Converted integer:", i)

A nil `error` denotes success; a non-nil `error` denotes failure.

.play methods/errors.go
context_inventory.target:

（与 `fmt.Stringer` 类似， `fmt` 包在
打印值时也会检查待打印的值是否实现了 `error` 接口。）

函数通常会返回一个 `error` 值，调用方应通过判断该错误是否为
`nil` 来处理错误。

	i, err := strconv.Atoi("42")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("couldn't convert number: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("Converted integer:", i)

`error` 为 nil 表示成功；非 nil 的 `error` 表示失败。

* Readers

The `io` package specifies the `io.Reader` interface,
which represents the read end of a stream of data.

The Go standard library contains [[https://cs.opensource.google/search?q=Read%5C(%5Cw%2B%5Cs%5C%5B%5C%5Dbyte%5C)&ss=go%2Fgo][many implementations]] of this interface, including files, network connections, compressors, ciphers, and others.

* Pointer receivers

You can declare methods with pointer receivers.

This means the receiver type has the literal syntax `*T` for some type `T`.
(Also, `T` cannot itself be a pointer such as `*int`.)

For example, the `Scale` method here is defined on `*Vertex`.

Methods with pointer receivers can modify the value to which the receiver
points (as `Scale` does here).
Since methods often need to modify their receiver, pointer receivers are more
common than value receivers.

Try removing the `*` from the declaration of the `Scale` function on line 16
and observe how the program's behavior changes.

With a value receiver, the `Scale` method operates on a copy of the original
`Vertex` value.
(This is the same behavior as for any other function argument.)
The `Scale` method must have a pointer receiver to change the `Vertex` value
declared in the `main` function.

（另外， `T` 本身不能是像 `*int` 这样的指针。）

例如，这里的 `Scale` 方法定义在 `*Vertex` 上。

使用指针接收者的方法可以修改接收者所指向的值
（这里的 `Scale` 就是如此）。
由于方法经常需要修改其接收者，因此指针接收者比值接收者更常见。

* Methods and pointer indirection

Comparing the previous two programs, you might notice that
functions with a pointer argument must take a pointer:

	var v Vertex
	ScaleFunc(v, 5)  // Compile error!
	ScaleFunc(&v, 5) // OK

while methods with pointer receivers take either a value or a pointer as the
receiver when they are called:

	var v Vertex
	v.Scale(5)  // OK
	p := &v
	p.Scale(10) // OK

For the statement `v.Scale(5)`, even though `v` is a value and not a pointer,
the method with the pointer receiver is called automatically.
That is, as a convenience, Go interprets the statement `v.Scale(5)` as
`(&v).Scale(5)` since the `Scale` method has a pointer receiver.

.play methods/indirection.go
context_inventory.target:
* 方法与指针间接引用

比较前两个程序，你可能会注意到，
带有指针参数的函数必须接收一个指针：

	var v Vertex
	ScaleFunc(v, 5)  // 编译错误！
	ScaleFunc(&v, 5) // OK

而使用指针接收者的方法在调用时，接收者既可以是值，也可以是指针：

	var v Vertex
	v.Scale(5)  // OK
	p := &v
	p.Scale(10) // OK

对于语句 `v.Scale(5)`，即使 `v` 是一个值而不是指针，
也会自动调用使用指针接收者的方法。
也就是说，为了方便，Go 会把语句 `v.Scale(5)` 解释为
`(&v).Scale(5)`，因为 `Scale` 方法使用指针接收者。

.play methods/indirection.go

* Methods and pointer indirection (2)

	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(&v)) // Compile error!

receiver when they are called:

	var v Vertex
	fmt.Println(v.Abs()) // OK
	p := &v
	fmt.Println(p.Abs()) // OK

	fmt.Println(AbsFunc(&v)) // 编译错误！

context_inventory.source:
* Choosing a value or pointer receiver

There are two reasons to use a pointer receiver.

The first is so that the method can modify the value that its receiver points to.

The second is to avoid copying the value on each method call.
This can be more efficient if the receiver is a large struct, for example.

In this example, both `Scale` and `Abs` are methods with receiver type `*Vertex`,
even though the `Abs` method needn't modify its receiver.

In general, all methods on a given type should have either value or pointer
receivers, but not a mixture of both.
(We'll see why over the next few pages.)

.play methods/methods-with-pointer-receivers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 选择值接收者还是指针接收者

使用指针接收者有两个原因。

第一，方法可以修改其接收者所指向的值。

第二，可以避免每次调用方法时都复制该值。
例如，如果接收者是一个大型结构体，这样做可能会更高效。

在这个例子中， `Scale` 和 `Abs` 都是接收者类型为 `*Vertex` 的方法，
尽管 `Abs` 方法并不需要修改其接收者。

一般来说，一个给定类型的所有方法应该统一使用值接收者或指针接收者，
而不应混合使用两者。
（接下来的几页会说明原因。）

* Pointers

Go has pointers.
A pointer holds the memory address of a value.

The type `*T` is a pointer to a `T` value. Its zero value is `nil`.

	var p *int

The `&` operator generates a pointer to its operand.

	i := 42
	p = &i

The `*` operator denotes the pointer's underlying value.

	fmt.Println(*p) // read i through the pointer p
	*p = 21         // set i through the pointer p

This is known as "dereferencing" or "indirecting".

Unlike C, Go has no pointer arithmetic.

.play moretypes/pointers.go
context_inventory.target:

	var p *int

	p = &i

`*` 运算符表示指针所指向的底层值。

	fmt.Println(*p) // 通过指针 p 读取 i

* Slice length and capacity

A slice has both a _length_ and a _capacity_.

The length of a slice is the number of elements it contains.

The capacity of a slice is the number of elements in the underlying array,
counting from the first element in the slice.

The length and capacity of a slice `s` can be obtained using the expressions
`len(s)` and `cap(s)`.

You can extend a slice's length by re-slicing it,
provided it has sufficient capacity.
Try changing one of the slice operations in the example program to extend it
beyond its capacity and see what happens.

* Appending to a slice

It is common to append new elements to a slice, and so Go provides a built-in
`append` function. The [[/pkg/builtin/#append][documentation]]
of the built-in package describes `append`.

	func append(s []T, vs ...T) []T

The first parameter `s` of `append` is a slice of type `T`, and the rest are
`T` values to append to the slice.

The resulting value of `append` is a slice containing all the elements of the
original slice plus the provided values.

If the backing array of `s` is too small to fit all the given values a bigger
array will be allocated. The returned slice will point to the newly allocated
array.

(To learn more about slices, read the [[/blog/go-slices-usage-and-internals][Slices: usage and internals]] article.)

（你需要使用循环，逐个为 `[]uint8` 分配空间；这些切片位于 `[][]uint8` 中。）

（使用 `uint8(intValue)` 在类型之间进行转换。）

context_inventory.source:
* Maps

A map maps keys to values.

The zero value of a map is `nil`.
A `nil` map has no keys, nor can keys be added.

The `make` function returns a map of the given type,
initialized and ready for use.

.play moretypes/maps.go
context_inventory.target:
* 映射

映射将键映射到值。

映射的零值为 `nil`。
一个 `nil` 映射没有任何键，也不能向其中添加键。

`make` 函数会返回指定类型的映射，
该映射已经初始化，可以直接使用。

.play moretypes/maps.go

context_inventory.source:
* Structs

A `struct` is a collection of fields.

.play moretypes/structs.go
context_inventory.target:
* 结构体

`struct` 是字段的集合。

.play moretypes/structs.go

context_inventory.source:
* Map literals

Map literals are like struct literals, but the keys are required.

.play moretypes/map-literals.go
context_inventory.target:
* 映射字面量

映射字面量与结构体字面量类似，但必须指定键。

.play moretypes/map-literals.go

context_inventory.source:
* Map literals continued

If the top-level type is just a type name, you can omit it from the elements of the literal.

.play moretypes/map-literals-continued.go
context_inventory.target:
* 映射字面量（续）

如果顶层类型只是一个类型名，那么在字面量的各个元素中可以省略该类型。

.play moretypes/map-literals-continued.go

context_inventory.source:
* Mutating Maps

Insert or update an element in map `m`:

	m[key] = elem

Retrieve an element:

	elem = m[key]

Delete an element:

	delete(m, key)

Test that a key is present with a two-value assignment:

	elem, ok = m[key]

If `key` is in `m`, `ok` is `true`. If not, `ok` is `false`.

If `key` is not in the map, then `elem` is the zero value for the map's element type.

*Note:* If `elem` or `ok` have not yet been declared you could use a short declaration form:

	elem, ok := m[key]

.play moretypes/mutating-maps.go
context_inventory.target:
* 修改映射

在映射 `m` 中插入或更新元素：

	m[key] = elem

获取元素：

	elem = m[key]

删除元素：

	delete(m, key)

使用双赋值来测试某个键是否存在：

	elem, ok = m[key]

如果 `key` 存在于 `m` 中，则 `ok` 为 `true`；否则， `ok` 为 `false`。

如果 `key` 不在映射中，那么 `elem` 将是该映射元素类型的零值。

*注意：* 如果 `elem` 或 `ok` 尚未声明，可以使用短变量声明形式：

	elem, ok := m[key]

.play moretypes/mutating-maps.go

Implement `WordCount`.  It should return a map of the counts of each “word” in the string `s`. The `wc.Test` function runs a test suite against the provided function and prints success or failure.

You might find [[/pkg/strings/#Fields][strings.Fields]] helpful.

.play moretypes/exercise-maps.go
context_inventory.target:

实现 `WordCount`。它应返回一个映射，记录字符串 `s` 中每个“单词”出现的次数。 `wc.Test` 函数会针对你提供的函数运行一组测试，并输出成功或失败的结果。

你可能会发现 [[/pkg/strings/#Fields][strings.Fields]] 很有帮助。

context_inventory.source:
* Function values

Functions are values too. They can be passed around just like other values.

Function values may be used as function arguments and return values.

.play moretypes/function-values.go
context_inventory.target:
* 函数值

函数也是值。它们可以像其他值一样被传递。

函数值可以用作函数参数和返回值。

.play moretypes/function-values.go

context_inventory.source:
* Function closures

Go functions may be closures. A closure is a function value that references variables from outside its body. The function may access and assign to the referenced variables; in this sense the function is "bound" to the variables.

For example, the `adder` function returns a closure. Each closure is bound to its own `sum` variable.

.play moretypes/function-closures.go
context_inventory.target:
* 函数闭包

Go 的函数可以是闭包。闭包是一个引用其函数体之外变量的函数值。函数可以访问这些被引用的变量，也可以为它们赋值；从这个意义上说，函数与这些变量是“绑定”的。

例如， `adder` 函数会返回一个闭包。每个闭包都绑定到各自的 `sum` 变量。

.play moretypes/function-closures.go

Let's have some fun with functions.

Implement a `fibonacci` function that returns a function (a closure) that
returns successive [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fibonacci_number][fibonacci numbers]]
(0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...).

.play moretypes/exercise-fibonacci-closure.go

实现一个 `fibonacci` 函数，它返回另一个函数（闭包），
该函数依次返回 [[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fibonacci_number][斐波那契数]]
（0、1、1、2、3、5……）。

Struct fields are accessed using a dot.

context_inventory.source:
* Pointers to structs

Struct fields can be accessed through a struct pointer.

To access the field `X` of a struct when we have the struct pointer `p` we could
write `(*p).X`.
However, that notation is cumbersome, so the language permits us instead to
write just `p.X`, without the explicit dereference.

.play moretypes/struct-pointers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 指向结构体的指针

可以通过结构体指针访问结构体字段。

要访问结构体的字段 `X`，而我们持有的是结构体指针 `p`，可以
写成 `(*p).X`。
不过，这种写法很繁琐，因此可以直接
写成 `p.X`，而无需显式解引用。

.play moretypes/struct-pointers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Struct Literals

A struct literal denotes a newly allocated struct value by listing the values of its fields.

You can list just a subset of fields by using the `Name:` syntax. (And the order of named fields is irrelevant.)

The special prefix `&` returns a pointer to the struct value.

.play moretypes/struct-literals.go
context_inventory.target:
* 结构体字面量

结构体字面量通过列出各字段的值来表示一个新分配的结构体值。

使用 `Name:` 语法时，可以只列出部分字段。（已命名字段的顺序无关紧要。）

特殊前缀 `&` 会返回一个指向该结构体值的指针。

.play moretypes/struct-literals.go

context_inventory.source:
* Arrays

The type `[n]T` is an array of `n` values of type `T`.

The expression

	var a [10]int

declares a variable `a` as an array of ten integers.

An array's length is part of its type, so arrays cannot be resized.
This seems limiting, but don't worry;
Go provides a convenient way of working with arrays.

.play moretypes/array.go
context_inventory.target:
* 数组

类型 `[n]T` 表示一个由 `n` 个 `T` 类型的值组成的数组。

表达式

	var a [10]int

将变量 `a` 声明为一个包含十个整数的数组。

数组的长度是其类型的一部分，因此数组不能调整大小。
这看起来有些受限，但不用担心；
Go 提供了处理数组的便捷方式。

.play moretypes/array.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slices

An array has a fixed size.
A slice, on the other hand, is a dynamically-sized,
flexible view into the elements of an array.
In practice, slices are much more common than arrays.

The type `[]T` is a slice with elements of type `T`.

A slice is formed by specifying two indices, a low and
high bound, separated by a colon:

	a[low : high]

This selects a half-open range which includes the first
element, but excludes the last one.

The following expression creates a slice which includes
elements 1 through 3 of `a`:

	a[1:4]

.play moretypes/slices.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片

数组的大小是固定的。
而切片则是对数组中一段元素的、大小动态可变的灵活视图。
在实际使用中，切片比数组更常见。

类型 `[]T` 表示一个元素类型为 `T` 的切片。

通过指定两个索引来形成切片，即由冒号分隔的下界和上界：

	a[low : high]

这会选择一个半开区间，其中包含第一个元素，但不包含最后一个元素。

下面的表达式创建了一个切片，其中包含 `a` 中索引 1 到 3 的元素：

	a[1:4]

.play moretypes/slices.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slices are like references to arrays

A slice does not store any data,
it just describes a section of an underlying array.

Changing the elements of a slice modifies the
corresponding elements of its underlying array.

Other slices that share the same underlying array will see those changes.

.play moretypes/slices-pointers.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片类似于数组的引用

切片本身并不存储任何数据，
它只是描述了底层数组中的一段。

修改切片中的元素，会同时修改其底层数组中对应的元素。

共享同一个底层数组的其他切片也会看到这些变化。

.play moretypes/slices-pointers.go

context_inventory.source:
* Slice literals

A slice literal is like an array literal without the length.

This is an array literal:

	[3]bool{true, true, false}

And this creates the same array as above,
then builds a slice that references it:

	[]bool{true, true, false}

.play moretypes/slice-literals.go
context_inventory.target:
* 切片字面量

切片字面量就像省略了长度的数组字面量。

这是一个数组字面量：

	[3]bool{true, true, false}

而下面的写法会创建与上面相同的数组，
然后构建一个引用该数组的切片：

	[]bool{true, true, false}

.play moretypes/slice-literals.go

* The Go Playground

web service that runs on [[/][golang.org]]'s servers.

The service receives a Go program, compiles, links, and runs the program inside
a sandbox, then returns the output.

There are limitations to the programs that can be run in the playground:

- In the playground the time begins at 2009-11-10 23:00:00 UTC (determining the significance of this date is an exercise for the reader). This makes it easier to cache programs by giving them deterministic output.

- There are also limits on execution time and on CPU and memory usage, and the program cannot access external network hosts.

The playground uses the latest stable release of Go.

Read "[[/blog/playground][Inside the Go Playground]]" to learn more.
